summary: Kootenai NF lookout on Green Mountain, Sanders County, MT: 50 ft pole L-4 built 1936, staffed 1956-59, destroyed 1966 per firelookout.com.

facts.status_note: Destroyed 1966 per firelookout.com; Rex's page lists it only as Removed, undated; FFLA index lists Tower Gone

events.note: Developed as a camp in 1933, per firelookout.com
Dean Henderson on the lookout in summer 1956 (Sandpoint News-Bulletin, as quoted)
Dean Henderson stationed at the lookout for the summer; he had been up 73 days when he came down in September
Crew began repairing the telephone line to the lookout (Sandpoint News-Bulletin, June 1958, as quoted)
Charley Madsen listed as lookout personnel, per firelookout.com
Destroyed 1966 per firelookout.com; Rex's page lists it only as Removed with no date

evidence.supports: developed as a camp in 1933; 50 ft pole L-4 built in 1936; destroyed in 1966
evidence.quote: Developed as a camp in 1933, this 50' pole L-4 tower, built in 1936, was destroyed in 1966.

evidence.supports: Dean Henderson on the lookout in 1956
evidence.quote: Dean Henderson, who is a local boy, is on Green mountain.
Dean Henderson left this week for Green mountain lookout where he will be stationed this summer.

evidence.supports: 73 days up at the lookout in 1957
evidence.quote: Dean had been up at the lookout the past 73 days

evidence.supports: Sept 26, 1957 item: Dean hiked out after 73 days
evidence.quote: Dean Henderson hiked out from the Green mountain lookout last Wednesday morning.
a crew has started work on repairing the telephone line to Green mountain lookout

evidence.supports: page lists the site as Removed with no date
Kootenai National Forest on the local page
Sandpoint News-Bulletin as the source of the 1956-1958 items

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says destroyed in 1966; Rex's page says Removed with no date. Both record the tower as gone. The year 1966 comes from firelookout.com alone.

notes_for_editor: Build year 1936 and destruction year 1966 come from firelookout.com alone; Rex's page says only Removed. Staffing is from 1956-1959 newspaper items quoted on Rex's page plus one firelookout.com personnel line. No source read describes what remains on the mountain or public access. The 50 ft height is the record's tower height as stated, converted to metres. Two WebSearch calls used; neither found a current description of the site.
